code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    green = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 3]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in green), max(r for r, c in green)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in green), max(c for r, c in green)
    markers = [(r, c) for r, c in green if r0 < r < r1 and c0 < c < c1]
    mr, mc = markers[0]
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            d = max(abs(r - mr), abs(c - mc))
            out[r][c] = 3 if d == 0 else (4 if d % 2 else 2)
    return out
'''
